extraction.Name: James Mesteth
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee but took it because he was told that if he did not take it and pay the taxes that he would lose the land to pay them
extraction.Buyer: Chris Christenson for $200.00 and a ford car, valued at about $200.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so he had to sell his land or lose it
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms as much as he can, milks cows and does common labor for a living, making about $300.00 per year
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in good health; has a wife and six children to support; has no land, only 4 cows and ten horses; has no home and lives on a tract of land he leases from the Security Bank, Rapid City, So. Dak.; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since he was granted a patent in fee; document subscribed and sworn before a Notary Public on November 30, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota
